content: {"episode_id":"ep-05096","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-50 denial of CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, for episode ep-05096. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I34.0, R00.2, and R42. As the note states, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias. We request reconsideration of the determination that this service was not medically necessary."}
